##### Other
In order for an application to support multiple versions of React, the MFEs must use the mfeInit function which the framework now supports.
While this update is not required to upgrade, it is something your team should do as soon as you are able to.
Here is the migration guide: https://powerschoolgroup.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/~brian.bjork@powerschool.com/pages/65268154382/MFE+Init+Function+Migration+Guide
